data.one_liner: A powerful text editor widget for Flutter handling 1M+ lines with LSP and AI completion.
data.what_it_does: Provides a high-performance, VS Code-level text and code editor widget built using rope data structures and low-level rendering. It features 180+ syntax highlighting languages, code folding, multi-cursor support, Language Server Protocol (LSP) integration, and AI-powered ghost text code completion.
use_when: You need to embed a code editor or IDE-like interface inside a Flutter application.
You require handling large text files with 1M+ lines smoothly.
You need built-in LSP integration or AI code completion inside an editor widget.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, single-line text input field.
You are building a standard form and just need basic text wrapping or formatting.
strengths: Optimized rope data structure handles massive files efficiently without dropping frames.
Built-in Language Server Protocol (LSP) client support over WebSockets and stdio.
Extensive feature set including multi-cursor, syntax highlighting, and AI completion.
weaknesses: Complex setup required if configuring custom LSP servers or WebSocket proxies.
Heavy package size due to numerous advanced dependencies and feature sets.
data.setup_notes: Requires importing language and theme definitions from re_highlight. LSP servers require external binaries or WebSocket proxies (like lsp-ws-proxy) configured.
